settings.html:
<script>
(function () {
  function setupRenaFaq() {
    var faq = document.querySelector('.fl-node-39egxpuv75i2');
    if (!faq || faq.dataset.rrFaqReady) return;
    faq.dataset.rrFaqReady = 'true';

    faq.querySelectorAll('.rr-faq-item').forEach(function (item, index) {
      var heading = item.querySelector('.fl-module-heading.fl-heading, .fl-module-heading .fl-heading');
      var answer = item.querySelector('.fl-module-rich-text');
      if (!heading || !answer) return;

      var question = heading.textContent.trim();
      var answerId = 'rr-faq-answer-' + (index + 1);
      var button = document.createElement('button');
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      var icon = document.createElement('span');

      button.type = 'button';
      button.className = 'rr-faq-toggle';
      button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      button.setAttribute('aria-controls', answerId);
      icon.className = 'rr-faq-icon';
      icon.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      icon.textContent = '▶';
      label.className = 'rr-faq-question';
      label.textContent = question;
      button.appendChild(icon);
      button.appendChild(label);

      heading.textContent = '';
      heading.appendChild(button);
      answer.id = answerId;
      answer.hidden = true;
      item.classList.add('rr-faq-enhanced');

      button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var expanded = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', expanded ? 'false' : 'true');
        answer.hidden = expanded;
        item.classList.toggle('rr-faq-open', !expanded);
        icon.textContent = expanded ? '▶' : '▼';
      });
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setupRenaFaq);
  } else {
    setupRenaFaq();
  }
})();
</script>
